purpose: Release behavior coverage for a developer-facing coding agent

scenarios.name: Installed CLI startup
Natural language docs compliance
Bugfix with regression test
Read-only review
Read-only analysis
Harmless native stderr
Runtime identity
Output isolation
Wrapper finalizes incomplete compliance output
scenarios.expected: PARTIAL compliance matrix from repository evidence; never false PASS

scenarios.name: Wrapper promotes incomplete bugfix output only after verification
scenarios.expected: PASS only with changed files, deterministic checks passing, no guardrail violations, and independent review not FAIL

scenarios.name: Transcript mentions compliance matrix but terminal report omits it
scenarios.expected: terminal report is rejected as malformed; recovery/finalizer produces canonical COMPLIANCE MATRIX

scenarios.name: Compliance recovery extracts requirements when Git inventory is incomplete or path-normalization differs
scenarios.expected: docs/requirements.md is scanned directly and REQ-01..REQ-04 are available to wrapper finalizer

scenarios.name: Regression verifier contains a literal $Variable token in a regex
scenarios.expected: sandbox/meta verifier rejects unsafe double-quoted pattern before Windows qualification

scenarios.name: Compliance recovery process fails but repository docs are locally readable
scenarios.expected: wrapper still extracts REQ-01..REQ-04 and writes canonical COMPLIANCE MATRIX; model exit failure remains visible in verification

scenarios.name: Pre-live Windows runtime compliance extractor self-test
scenarios.expected: module-scope extractor returns REQ-01..REQ-04 and emits diagnostic path before install/live E2E

scenarios.name: Live E2E failure diagnostic bundle
scenarios.expected: console + persistent transcript show fixture tree, requirements file, session, model/recovery output, extractor diagnostics and preserved fixture

scenarios.name: Qualification logging must not mutate or contaminate package verification
scenarios.expected: logs are emitted outside package root; package profile scan covers distributable sources only

scenarios.name: Model emits COMPLIANCE MATRIX before FINAL RESULT
scenarios.expected: analysis output is accepted without unnecessary recovery when matrix table and terminal status are both present

scenarios.name: Qualification child script uses named parameters
scenarios.expected: -Profile Full and -Project <path> bind correctly and any ParameterBindingException produces non-zero step status

scenarios.name: Compliance extractor throws on Windows
scenarios.expected: diagnostic file contains exact stage, exception type/message and position before the error propagates

scenarios.name: PowerShell diagnostic string contains variable followed by colon
Iterative development in one stable source directory
scenarios.expected: changes are applied in-place under local-coding-agent; Git provides history/rollback; release version changes only after qualification passes

scenarios.name: Long local-model execution produces no immediate final answer
scenarios.expected: normal UI emits heartbeat every 10 seconds, surfaces recognized tool/file activity, warns after 60 seconds without new output, shows Ctrl+C cancellation, and stops the process tree after the hard timeout

scenarios.name: Russian read-only analysis starts with seven pre-existing Git changes and model final result is missing
scenarios.expected: UI remains Russian, reports changed-by-agent separately from seven pre-existing changes, does not show Developer report, and marks the analysis FAIL instead of presenting a provisional pseudo-result

scenarios.name: DEV install after VERIFY-PACKAGE PASS under Set-StrictMode
scenarios.expected: DEV continues into Full regression and install without VariableIsUndefined for LASTEXITCODE

scenarios.name: Run agent from a new/unmarked project after previously using help-pass
scenarios.expected: banner/root/evidence use the current directory; agent never silently analyzes help-pass, and /status does not show help-pass history as current-project status

scenarios.name: Repository contains only root main.md and user says 'отредактируй main.md до статуса полноценной мастер спеки'
scenarios.expected: discovery reports main.md as documentation; router selects mutating /docs; the run cannot report PARTIAL/PASS unless main.md or another requested project file is actually changed
